regions=[(2,10,3,8,2,6,[[0,1,0],[1,0,1],[1,1,0]]),
         (4,11,13,18,10,13,[[4,0],[4,4]]),
         (16,21,3,10,19,7,[[3,0,3,3],[0,3,0,3],[3,3,0,3]])]
for r0,r1,c0,c1,ar,ac,p in regions:

  for c in range(c0,c1+1): G[r][c]=p[(r-ar)%len(p)][(c-ac)%len(p[0])]
assert len(G)==26 and all(len(row)==22 for row in G)
